title: GOP Rep. James Comer launches campaign for Kentucky governor
description: Comer announced his campaign weeks before Democrats are set to retake the majority in the House.

title: Trump berates NBC reporter, says she wouldn’t notice ‘broken windows’
description: Trump also called Yamiche Alcindor “pathetic,” while touting his construction projects.

title: After years of attacks, LGBTQ voters are ready for some wins
description: With Democrats slated to take total control of Congress next year, political operatives and organizations are ready to make demands.

title: Trump pushes more White House renovations in wake of GOP midterm loss
description: The president has claimed he is paying for the White House makeover, but the Park Service is set to foot much of the bill.

title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
description: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
description: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

title: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
description: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
description: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

title: After Democrats' midterm wins, some hope attacks on DEI will ease
description: After the midterms, a Democratic congressman declared that DEI is back. What does Democrats' ascendance portend for diversity initiatives that the Trump administration has relentlessly attacked?

title: Trump’s library took in $57.6 million. Its donors are not listed.
description: It’s unclear how much came from multimillion-dollar settlements with ABC, Meta and Paramount, which agreed to fund the project to end lawsuits Trump brought against them.

title: Trump takes less secure plane to China
description: On his last foreign trip, leaving Turkey involved an elaborate plane-switching ruse.

title: Longtime budget watchdog is retiring, handing Democrats a CBO opportunity
description: Phillip Swagel will leave his role in January as director of the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office.

title: Trump picks nominee to head watchdog agency
description: Eric Ueland’s nomination to lead the Government Accountability Office was criticized as failing to follow proper congressional process.

title: Judge tosses Max Miller’s suit against ex-wife, says abuse claim ‘substantially true’
description: Emily Moreno has claimed in court filings that Miller tossed hot water on her, held a gun to her head and threw her against a wall. Miller has denied the allegations.

title: White House weighs next steps for FDA nominee who faces bipartisan pushback
description: Heidi Overton's nomination has faced an uphill battle as some in the GOP, many Democrats and prominent Make America Healthy Again supporters have questioned or opposed her candidacy.

title: Supreme Court hands Trump a setback on DEI-related grant cancellations
description: The justices declined to consider the administration’s request to revive its cuts to grant funding to researchers at the University of California at Berkeley.

title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
description: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

title: Trump floats meeting with Kim Jong Un while in Asia
description: The president is already scheduled to meet with several world leaders this week to discuss nuclear disarmament.

title: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
description: The new rule closes a loophole that existed that allowed Chinese companies to still access advanced AI chips remotely, despite U.S. restrictions on their physical sale to China.

title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
description: Countries are meeting in Geneva to negotiate rules on weapons that can select and kill targets without human intervention. But with the U.S., Russia and Israel resisting legally binding controls, campaigners fear the window to act is closing.

title: Nearly two million people are behind bars in the US. How did we get here?
description:
Lynn Novick's new, four-part PBS documentary series, Crime and Punishment in America, goes inside the U.S. prison system and explores how
our approach to criminals has changed over time.

title: Lindsay Clancy to face a new trial in spring of 2027 over children's killing
description: A new trial is set in Massachusetts against Lindsay Clancy as prosecutors seek a criminal conviction over the killing of her three young children.

title: Biden looks backward, as the Democratic Party moves forward
description: His focus is now on litigating his place in history, not the future of the party he once led.

title: How Annie Andrews went from liberal gun-control activist to unlikely red-state senator
description: The South Carolina Democrat will now be colleagues with Republicans she parodied online.

title: Midterm losses, Nvidia scandal weaken Trump as he faces Xi and Putin
description: As the president heads to Asia, his advisers are divided on key issues, and his diminished political influence may make other leaders wary of deals.

title: The surprising new face of the MAHA-MAGA alliance: Stephen Miller
description: Health chief Robert F. Kennedy Jr. says the new White House chief of staff is even “more radical” than he is, encouraging MAHA supporters but worrying critics.

title: After Senate win, Scott Colom says Democrats need to invest more in Mississippi
description: With his upset victory over Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, Colom is set to become Mississippi’s first Democratic U.S. senator since John C. Stennis retired in 1989.

title: GOP glare on Lutnick grows amid Nvidia scandal
description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress in a closed-door meeting.

title: Chris Van Hollen says he has support in his bid to replace Chuck Schumer
description: Schumer has said he has the votes to win the race. Van Hollen said on “Fox News Sunday” that he has about 15 votes.
